title: Layer-wise fabrication method with binder jetting
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. Variants include lattice support structures designed for easy removal. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; an orientation planner minimising overhang area; and lattice support structures designed for easy removal.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with binder jetting
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. Variants include lattice support structures designed for easy removal. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm; and lattice support structures designed for easy removal.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.

title: Protective coating system with thermal barrier and sol-gel layer (continuation)
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a protective coating system. The protective coating system comprises a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. Additionally, a fluorinated topcoat repelling water is provided. This lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content.

title: Laser melting machine with binder jetting and powder recycling
abstract: A laser melting machine is disclosed that includes a powder bed fusion machine with fixed laser power and post-build inspection by tomography. In some embodiments the laser melting machine further includes a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a powder bed fusion machine with fixed laser power and post-build inspection by tomography; a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.

title: Energy storage assembly with cell balancing (continuation)
abstract: A energy storage assembly is described that has a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. In certain embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall and a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall; and a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.

title: Coating composition with thermal barrier and anti-fouling paint
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coating composition. The coating composition comprises a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying and a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly. Additionally, a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate is provided. This improves adhesion on steel.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly; and a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.

title: Coating composition with thermal barrier
abstract: A coating composition is disclosed that includes an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface. In some embodiments the coating composition further includes microcapsules containing a corrosion inhibitor that release when a crack forms in the coating and graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface; microcapsules containing a corrosion inhibitor that release when a crack forms in the coating; and graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising curing by ultraviolet light-emitting diodes to a dry film thickness of 80 to 120 micrometres.
3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising an undercoat loaded with zinc dust protecting the steel galvanically.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with binder jetting and orientation planning
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. Variants include hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores. The design reduces porosity in finished parts while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; an orientation planner minimising overhang area; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with stress relief and graded lattice
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes a coaxial camera used only for recording build documentation. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a post-build stress-relief heat treatment and a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size. The arrangement shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a coaxial camera used only for recording build documentation; a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; and a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Battery module with air-cooled housing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery module. The battery module comprises a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows and an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. Additionally, a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside is provided. This lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell; and a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section.

title: Machine health sensor with edge unit
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. The machine health sensor comprises an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. Additionally, a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system; an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter; and a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising an ultrasonic transducer pair measuring transit time through the pipe wall.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory.

title: Battery module with air-cooled housing (continuation)
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by an intumescent barrier and a venting channel that directs ejected gas away from adjacent cells. Variants include a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit. The design lowers temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: an intumescent barrier and a venting channel that directs ejected gas away from adjacent cells; a bidirectional refrigerant circuit warming the pack before charging at low temperature; and a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a phase-change material layer disposed between adjacent battery cells to absorb heat.
3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising a cold plate with meandering micro-channels carrying liquid coolant beneath the cells.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with sol-gel layer
abstract: A corrosion protection scheme is disclosed that includes a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. In some embodiments the corrosion protection scheme further includes a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water. The arrangement reduces maintenance repainting.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating; a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.

title: Machine health sensor with proximity sensing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. The machine health sensor comprises an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. Additionally, a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target; a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; and a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings.

title: Sensor node with humidity compensation
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link. The arrangement shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.

title: Sensor node with thermocouple assembly and fibre sensing
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. The arrangement reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell; a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure; and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings.

title: Protective coating system with hydrophobic topcoat and abrasion resistance
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes a fluorinated topcoat repelling water and photo-curing with solid-state UV lamps yielding a dry layer of about one hundred micrometres. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; a fluorinated topcoat repelling water; and photo-curing with solid-state UV lamps yielding a dry layer of about one hundred micrometres.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising layered carbon nanoplatelets lying flat in a thermoset binder forming a barrier.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a silane primer treatment over sand-blasted steel to improve bonding.
4. The protective coating system of claim 3, further comprising ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance.

title: Battery pack with graphite sheet
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes a thermal runaway alarm triggered only by a gas concentration sensor. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall and a busbar with an integrated heat sink. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a thermal runaway alarm triggered only by a gas concentration sensor; a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall; and a busbar with an integrated heat sink.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.

title: Protective coating system with carbon film
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. The arrangement reduces maintenance repainting.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy; and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating.

title: Sensor node with pressure transmitter
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. The arrangement extends battery life.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target; and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.

title: Thermal management system with thermal interface pad and air-cooled housing
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface. Variants include a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane. The design extends cycle life while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface; a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; and a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Powder bed fusion system with scan strategy
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a powder bed fusion system. The powder bed fusion system comprises a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores. Additionally, a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper is provided. This reduces porosity in finished parts.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores; and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with distortion simulation

title: Machine health sensor with level radar and safety barrier
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. title: Thermal management system with heat spreader foils

title: Battery module with heating film and immersion cooling
abstract: A battery module is disclosed that includes a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside. title: Wireless monitoring system with proximity sensing

The arrangement improves adhesion on steel.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating; an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Condition monitoring device with level radar
abstract: Embodiments of a condition monitoring device are described, characterised by a wired vibration sensor powered from a mains supply that transmits continuously. Variants include a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.

title: Coating composition with hydrophobic topcoat (continuation)

title: Powder bed fusion system with part marking
abstract: Embodiments of a powder bed fusion system are described, characterised by a shielding gas stream monitored by an oxygen analyser and a spatter deflector. title: Energy storage assembly with heating film and cell balancing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a energy storage assembly. The energy storage assembly comprises a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases and a heat-pumping loop operable in heating mode to raise pack temperature in cold weather. Additionally, a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside is provided. This lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; a heat-pumping loop operable in heating mode to raise pack temperature in cold weather; and a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path.
3. The energy storage assembly of claim 2, further comprising a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.
4. The energy storage assembly of claim 3, further comprising a latent-heat storage sheet sandwiched between adjoining cells of the module.

title: Energy storage assembly with fan control and derated charging
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a energy storage assembly. The energy storage assembly comprises a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature and a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases. Additionally, a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall is provided. This improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; and a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Thermal management system with heat pipe
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a thermal management system. The thermal management system comprises a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path and a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section. Additionally, a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path; a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section; and a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.

title: Energy storage assembly with cell balancing
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall; and a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with hydrophobic topcoat and carbon film
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a corrosion protection scheme. The corrosion protection scheme comprises a fluorinated topcoat repelling water and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Additionally, a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness is provided. This reduces maintenance repainting.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a fluorinated topcoat repelling water; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.

title: Powder bed fusion system with scan strategy
abstract: Embodiments of a powder bed fusion system are described, characterised by a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers. Variants include a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores; and a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with graded lattice
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels. The arrangement shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size; a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.

title: Condition monitoring device with fibre sensing
abstract: A condition monitoring device is disclosed that includes a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure. In some embodiments the condition monitoring device further includes a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure; a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings.

title: Battery pack with fan control and cell balancing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery pack. The battery pack comprises a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. Additionally, a busbar with an integrated heat sink is provided. This improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; and a busbar with an integrated heat sink.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section.

title: Coated article with abrasion resistance
abstract: A coated article is disclosed that includes ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance. In some embodiments the coated article further includes a fluorinated topcoat repelling water and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. The arrangement improves adhesion on steel.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; a fluorinated topcoat repelling water; and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition.

title: Thermal management system with heat spreader foils and derated charging
abstract: A thermal management system is disclosed that includes an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. In some embodiments the thermal management system further includes a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases and a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell; a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; and a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a busbar with an integrated heat sink.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Sensor node with long-range gateway
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sensor node. The sensor node comprises clock alignment so measurements from several devices carry coherent time labels and an energy-scavenging transducer converting mechanical oscillation into supply power for the device. Additionally, a duty-cycled wireless mesh link sending data solely upon an abnormality indication is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: clock alignment so measurements from several devices carry coherent time labels; an energy-scavenging transducer converting mechanical oscillation into supply power for the device; and a duty-cycled wireless mesh link sending data solely upon an abnormality indication.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an inertial chip read at a variable acquisition rate scaled to vibration intensity.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising local spectrum analysis followed by a learned model scoring deviation from normal behaviour at the node.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.

title: Thermal management system with fan control
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a thermal management system. The thermal management system comprises a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows. Additionally, a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells is provided. This improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.

title: Protective coating system with abrasion resistance and powder coating
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance. Variants include an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating. The design extends service life in marine environments while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically; and an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.

title: Condition monitoring device with scheduled logger
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a condition monitoring device. The condition monitoring device comprises a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up and a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure. Additionally, a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up; a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure; and a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with low-solvent binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a corrosion protection scheme. The corrosion protection scheme comprises a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content and ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance. Additionally, a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy is provided. This extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; and a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Laser melting machine with binder jetting and stress relief
abstract: A laser melting machine is disclosed that includes a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. In some embodiments the laser melting machine further includes a post-build stress-relief heat treatment and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.

title: Condition monitoring device with scheduled logger
abstract: Embodiments of a condition monitoring device are described, characterised by correcting sensor offset drift with readings from a nearby thermal resistor. Variants include a duty-cycled wireless mesh link sending data solely upon an abnormality indication. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: correcting sensor offset drift with readings from a nearby thermal resistor; a vibration-driven piezo generator supplying electrical power to the wireless node; and a duty-cycled wireless mesh link sending data solely upon an abnormality indication.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising an embedded processor deriving frequency-domain features and a neural reconstruction-error measure of abnormality.
3. The condition monitoring device of claim 2, further comprising a micromachined acceleration transducer whose sampling frequency is raised upon larger oscillation levels.

title: Battery pack with heat spreader foils
abstract: Embodiments of a battery pack are described, characterised by an expanding fire-retardant layer together with an exhaust duct guiding vented gases out of the housing. Variants include a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit. The design enhances fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: an expanding fire-retardant layer together with an exhaust duct guiding vented gases out of the housing; a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting; and a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a cold plate with meandering micro-channels carrying liquid coolant beneath the cells.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a control unit setting pump speed from a forecast of temperature differences across the cells.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with distortion simulation and orientation planning
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a additive manufacturing apparatus. The additive manufacturing apparatus comprises a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry and an orientation planner minimising overhang area. Additionally, a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability is provided. This shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry; an orientation planner minimising overhang area; and a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers.
3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with intumescent paint
abstract: A corrosion protection scheme is disclosed that includes an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat. In some embodiments the corrosion protection scheme further includes a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. The arrangement extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat; a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness; and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with shielding paint
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a corrosion protection scheme. The corrosion protection scheme comprises curing by ultraviolet light-emitting diodes to a dry film thickness of 80 to 120 micrometres and an in-film impedance spectroscopy probe tracking deterioration of the protective layer. Additionally, an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface is provided. This extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: curing by ultraviolet light-emitting diodes to a dry film thickness of 80 to 120 micrometres; an in-film impedance spectroscopy probe tracking deterioration of the protective layer; and an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix.
3. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 2, further comprising encapsulated inhibitor-filled shells that rupture upon cracking and discharge their payload.
4. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 3, further comprising a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Thermal management system with heating film and sealed enclosure
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid. Variants include a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane. The design lowers parasitic cooling power while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; a bidirectional refrigerant circuit warming the pack before charging at low temperature; and a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a processor regulating coolant throughput according to a model predicting thermal gradients between cells.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
4. The thermal management system of claim 3, further comprising an expanding fire-retardant layer together with an exhaust duct guiding vented gases out of the housing.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with stress relief and part marking
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a post-build stress-relief heat treatment. Variants include a counter-rotating roller spreading powder. The design reduces porosity in finished parts while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability; and a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising lattice support structures designed for easy removal.

title: Energy storage assembly with cell balancing
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases and an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid. The arrangement reduces temperature spread between cells.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; and an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid.

title: Thermal management system with immersion cooling
abstract: A thermal management system is disclosed that includes a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed. In some embodiments the thermal management system further includes a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. The arrangement improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Machine health sensor with thermocouple assembly
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. The machine health sensor comprises a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. Additionally, a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link is provided. This lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell; a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.

title: Wireless monitoring system with scheduled logger
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wireless monitoring system. The wireless monitoring system comprises a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. Additionally, an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area is provided. This extends battery life.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up; a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; and an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
3. The wireless monitoring system of claim 2, further comprising an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.

title: Laser melting machine with graded lattice
abstract: Embodiments of a laser melting machine are described, characterised by a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size. Variants include a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry. The design shortens qualification time while keeping cost low.

2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with distortion simulation (continuation)
abstract: A layer-wise fabrication method is disclosed that has a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry. In some embodiments the layer-wise fabrication method further includes a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers and an orientation planner minimising overhang area. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry; a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; and an orientation planner minimising overhang area.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
